impact_summary.value: FDA는 무균 표시 OTC 의약품의 무균성 입증, 원료 확인시험, 안정성 관리, 공정 밸리데이션 및 품질부서 운영에 중대한 CGMP 위반이 있다고 판단하고, 해당 제품이 오염되거나 품질·유효기간 요건을 충족하지 못할 우려가 있다고 설명했습니다. 미국 수입 의약품은 수입경보 대상이며 시정되지 않으면 수입 거부와 신규 신청 승인 보류가 가능하다고 알렸습니다.

evidence.quote: Because your methods, facilities, or controls for manufacturing, processing, packing, or holding of drugs as described in your response to our 704(a)(4) request do not conform to CGMP, your drug products are adulterated within the meaning of section 501(a)(2)(B) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (FD&C Act) (21 U.S.C. 351(a)(2)(B)).

FDA placed all drugs and drug products offered for import into the United States from your firm on Import Alert 66-40 on August 26, 2025. Correct any violations promptly. FDA may withhold approval of new applications or supplements listing your firm as a drug manufacturer until any violations are completely addressed and we confirm your compliance with CGMP.

affected_work.value: 대상은 미국으로 수입되는 회사의 OTC 의약품과 그 제조·시험·출하·품질 시스템입니다. 지적된 업무에는 무균 제조 및 시험, 원료·용기·마개 관리, 안정성 프로그램, 공정 및 설비 적격성, 제조용수 관리, 품질부서의 변경관리·불만·배치 검토 및 출하 등이 포함됩니다.

evidence.quote: Your firm manufactures OTC drug products, including (b)(4) that are labeled as sterile and indicated for use (b)(4) .

For example, your response indicated there were no QU procedures for change control, customer complaints, annual product review, batch review, batch release or rejection, reprocessing and reworking, returns and salvaging, specifications, deviations, or corrective action and preventive action.

recommendation.value: FDA는 무균성 달성 평가, 시험 규격·방법 및 유효기간 내 미국 유통 배치 보관검체의 전면 시험 계획과 결과를 제출하라고 요구했습니다. 부적합 품질이 확인되면 신속히 고객에게 알리고 회수하는 등 시정 조치를 하라고 했습니다. 또한 원료 시스템, 안정성 프로그램, 공정 적격성·제조용수 관리 및 품질부서의 평가·시정 계획과 관련 절차를 제출하고, 적격 컨설턴트의 지원과 전사 CGMP 감사를 강력히 권고했습니다.

evidence.quote: In response to this letter, provide: A comprehensive assessment of your manufacturing processes which evaluates how you achieve sterility in your drug products. A list of chemical and microbiological specifications, including test methods, used to analyze each lot of your drug products before a lot disposition decision.

o An action plan and timelines for conducting full chemical and microbiological testing of retain samples to determine the quality of all batches of drug products distributed to the U.S. that are within expiry as of the date of this letter. o A summary of all results obtained from testing retain samples from each batch. If such testing reveals substandard quality drug products, take rapid corrective actions, such as notifying customers and recalling product.

Based upon the nature of the violations we identified at your firm, we strongly recommend engaging a consultant qualified as set forth in 21 CFR 211.34 to assist your firm in meeting CGMP requirements.
After you receive this letter, respond to this office in writing within 15 working days. Specify what you have done to address any violations and to prevent their recurrence.
